interpretation: 306 whole-process opens/closes and68 RHS-span gap-edge opens could include capacity churn, initial mapping and final teardown. Eight ranks have more than16 projected bulk remote send allocations; rank23 has14 bulk and uncaptured surface allocations. All projected bulk remote send allocation sizes exceed1MiB. Counts do not identify repeated runtime keys or prove eviction. A16-versus128 capacity experiment is a direct hypothesis test only after binding actual knob values; no cause or speedup is established.

threshold_semantics.actual_gate: gpu_post.c333–339: skip only if bounds_len<threshold AND MPIDI_IPCI_is_repeat_addr(bounds_base)<1. Bounds are entire remote allocation, not message/peer segment.
threshold_semantics.host_mmap_choice: gpu_post.c645–657: do_mmap is src_data_sz<=MPIR_CVAR_GPU_FAST_COPY_MAX_SIZE for ZE, independent from allocation/repeat IPC admission.
threshold_semantics.shared_cache: MPL_ze_ipc_handle_mmap_host3254–3290 and MPL_gpu_ipc_handle_map1896–1965 share ipc_cache_mapped[dev_id] keyed remote_mem_id/dev_id/pid, reusing FDs.
threshold_semantics.counting: Host-only mmap insertion does not call update_lru_mapped_order. Device mapping calls it at1971–1973 and counts device ipc_buf entries per local device; converting a host-only cached entry to device mapping adds/updates that entry in LRU.
threshold_semantics.cleanup: LRU overflow closes/unmaps the device entry and associated host mapping if present; finalization also closes retained mappings.
threshold_semantics.default_protocol: gpu_post.c89–100 read;433–443 maps onto receiver local device.

captured_environment.actual_override_status: Unknown: these knobs/aliases were not included in selected ENV_KEYS. Reviewed launch scripts do not explicitly set or unset them; inherited module/PBS values cannot be excluded.

existing_bulk_plan.allocation_basis: MappedExchange creates one persistent send_buffer per plan on each sender; all receiver peer offsets share that sender allocation. Residual and physical plans are separate allocations. Same-node grouping uses verified contiguous12-rank host placement.
limits: CPU-generated plan projection, not GPU allocation/IPC interception.
Bulk only; surface, diagnostics, horizon and MPI-internal allocations excluded.
Cache lookup uses remote allocation identity and local map device; default read protocol maps to receiver local device. Actual CVAR values were not captured.

Peer payload sizes are descriptive only: actual source gates IPC using entire allocation bounds_len OR repeated base address, not per-peer message bytes. Kokkos view sizes provide requested allocation lower bounds.
